     5→import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Qualifier
     6→import org.springframework.http.HttpMethod
     7→import org.springframework.http.MediaType
     8→import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
     9→import org.springframework.web.reactive.function.client.WebClient
    10→import org.springframework.web.reactive.function.client.bodyToMono
    11→
    12→@Component
    13→class LegacyApiClient(
    14→    @field:Qualifier("LegacyWebClient")
    15→    private val client: WebClient,
    16→) {
    17→    private val logger by logger()
    18→
    19→    suspend fun pushQueue(
    20→        service: String,
    21→        method: HttpMethod,
    22→        body: Any,
    23→    ) {
    24→        try {
    25→            client
    26→                .method(method)
    27→                .uri("/pushQueue.json?service={service}", service)
    28→                .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
    29→                .bodyValue(body)
    30→                .retrieve()
    31→                .bodyToMono<String>()
    32→                .awaitSingle()
    33→        } catch (ex: Exception) {
    34→            logger.error { "Legacy API pushQueue 호출 실패 [service=$service]: $ex" }
    35→            throw ex
    36→        }
    37→    }
    38→}

#### Mock Testing Pattern (LegacySyncRepositoryImplTest)
**Location:** `/Users/admin/project/integrated-search/outbound-adapter/legacy/src/test/kotlin/com/cowave/search/outbound_adapter/legacy/LegacySyncRepositoryImplTest.kt`

```kotlin
class LegacySyncRepositoryImplTest : FunSpec({
    val legacyApiClient = mockk<LegacyApiClient>()
    val repository = LegacySyncRepositoryImpl(legacyApiClient)

    beforeEach {
        coEvery { legacyApiClient.pushQueue(any(), any(), any()) } returns Unit
    }

    context("pushLinkedProducts") {
        test("CREATE 연동상품 동기화 - POST로 호출한다") {
            val serviceSlot = slot<String>()
            val methodSlot = slot<HttpMethod>()
            
            coEvery {
                legacyApiClient.pushQueue(capture(serviceSlot), capture(methodSlot), any())
            } returns Unit
            
            repository.pushLinkedProducts(products, Operation.CREATE)
            
            serviceSlot.captured shouldBe "PDM"
            methodSlot.captured shouldBe HttpMethod.POST
            coVerify(exactly = 1) { legacyApiClient.pushQueue("PDM", HttpMethod.POST, products) }
        }
    }
})
```

**Key Features:**
- Uses MockK for mocking suspend functions with `coEvery`, `coVerify`
- Uses Kotest slot for capturing arguments
- Uses Kotest matchers (`shouldBe`)
- Tests verify service name, HTTP method, and body passed to client
